resources.string: App-wide choices apply immediately and are included in new settings backups.
Choose units for vehicle speed and navigation distance, independently of the app language.
Backup saved. Keep it private: it contains profile names and preferred phone addresses.
Backup could not be saved. Check the selected storage and try again.
Backup validated. Review the preview before replacing settings.
Backup rejected or unreadable. Choose a Cabin version 1 or 2 JSON backup, up to 32 KB. Nothing was changed.
Save profiles, buttons, shortcuts, projection preferences and units
Save or restore all three driver profiles, learned buttons, accessory shortcuts, projection preferences and measurement units. Adapter settings, vehicle firmware and logs are excluded.
Keep backups private: they include profile names and preferred phone addresses.
This replaces all three profiles, learned buttons and app shortcuts. Your current driver slot remains selected.
Night brightness: %1$d%% · Overlay recovery: %2$s · Compact launch: %3$s
Appearance and audio levels for the active profile apply immediately. No phone switch or app launch occurs. Shortcuts need their apps installed and available on this unit.
Vehicle firmware and CAN settings stay unchanged. Import only while parked.
Settings restored. No phone switch or app launch was requested.
Settings applied in memory, but storage failed. Export a backup and retry before restarting.
Import failed. Check storage and try again.
Version 1 backup: current projection preferences and measurement units will be kept.
